scene.note: Your functions use sets to drop repeats, remember what was heard, and compare two groups.

steps.note: The log has every call, and the same teams call again and again.
A set keeps each call sign once, however often it was heard.
Ailsa gets how many teams there really were.
The calls are gone through in the order they came.
Each call sign is looked for among those heard so far, then remembered.
The first one already heard comes back, or nothing if none was.
Friday's rota and Saturday's rota are two lists of names.
Each becomes a set, and only the names in both are kept.
A set of names comes back, in no particular order.
Ailsa wants any call sign the team does not know.
The known ones are taken away from the ones heard, each once.
The rest come back as a list in alphabetical order.
